parsed.why: No trans-specific offence or documented targeting; pride marches, drop-in centre and media/health protections show tolerated visibility. Hostile politics and non-implemented rulings concern partners, not visitors; residual exposure is social friction.

Police sustainably detain, beat and publicly humiliate 'men dressed as women' — direct state targeting of presentation. Life-max statute, no non-discrimination route, hate-crime killing with no hate response and alleged killer's escape; recourse absent.

State-engineered universal exposure: passport markers locked to assigned sex, visa refusal on sex-doubt with fraud/lifetime-ban threat, foreign travel advisories. Facility bans in ~21 states (criminal in four), custody conversion-style policy, immigration abuse; litigation pending, protections partial.

No trans offence, no documented targeting or violence, rare reported discrimination, enforced sexual-orientation hate-crime law. But no gender-identity protection, no LGR, near-zero visibility and Catholic disapproval; acceptance undocumented, so friction not hostility — moderate, unproven safety.

Criminalisation up to eight years plus lashes, official rejection of protections, UN-recorded hate crimes reaching perceived transgender people, pervasive stigma and no recourse. Enforcement rare, resorts welcoming, no universal trans-facing rule — hostile society with thin evidence.
